modelIntro.title: What Is Wan 2.5 AI Video Generator?
description: Wan 2.5 is an Alibaba Wan family video model for prompt-driven video creation. On Toolaze, it runs inside the shared AI video generator so you can start from text or upload one reference image, then describe motion, camera movement, lighting, and sound direction in one prompt.

The Toolaze Wan 2.5 setup focuses on short, controllable clips rather than long scenes: 5 or 10 seconds, 16:9, 9:16, or 1:1 framing, and 720p or 1080p output. It is useful when you want tactile product movement, ASMR-style material detail, clean social clips, or image-guided motion without switching tools.
Use Wan 2.5 when motion cues and audio-aware prompts matter, with model selection, upload, prompt examples, recent history, preview, and download available in one browser session.

promptExamples.title: Wan 2.5 Prompt Examples
promptExamples.subtitle: Copy these prompts when you want controlled motion, concise duration, and audio-aware video direction.

items.title: Rainy Market Audio Pass
items.prompt: Create a 10-second 9:16 Wan 2.5 video of a night market food stall in light rain. The camera pushes from a glowing menu sign to hands flipping scallion pancakes on a hot griddle. Add steam, reflected street lights, synchronized sizzling, rain on the tarp, and soft crowd ambience.
items.description: Native-audio scene prompt for ambience, food motion, rain detail, and synchronized sound.

items.title: Lantern Assembly Close-Up
items.prompt: Create a 5-second 9:16 close-up video of a compact camping lantern assembling on a workbench. Show brushed metal panels sliding into place, a thumb clicking the switch, warm light blooming through frosted glass, shallow depth of field, clean product shadows, and precise click and hum audio.
items.description: Tactile product prompt for compact assembly, material detail, and short synced audio cues.

items.title: One-Image Character Walk
items.prompt: Animate the uploaded full-body character concept into a 5-second 9:16 walking loop. Preserve the face, outfit, silhouette, and color palette from the reference image. Add a slow side-tracking camera, subtle coat and hair motion, wet neon reflections, and quiet footsteps without changing identity.
items.description: Image-to-video prompt for preserving one reference character while adding controlled motion.

items.title: Architectural Morning Glide
items.prompt: Create a 10-second 9:16 cinematic glide through a quiet modern courtyard house at sunrise. Start at a stone kitchen island, move past sliding glass doors, and end on plants moving in the courtyard. Keep vertical lines stable, natural shadows, soft room tone, birds outside, and no warped walls.
items.description: Camera-control prompt for stable architecture, natural lighting, and gentle environmental sound.

howToUse.title: How to Use Wan 2.5 on Toolaze

steps.title: Choose Wan 2.5
steps.desc: Open the model selector in the AI video generator and pick Wan 2.5 from the Wan model group.

steps.title: Pick a mode
steps.desc: Use text-to-video for a full scene prompt, or image-to-video when you want one uploaded reference image to guide the result.

steps.title: Set output options
steps.desc: Choose 16:9, 9:16, or 1:1, select 5 or 10 seconds, pick 720p or 1080p, and enable native audio when it fits the prompt.

steps.title: Generate and refine
steps.desc: Preview the clip, adjust motion or audio wording, recreate if needed, then download the video you want to keep.

troubleshooting.title: Prompt Tips for Better Wan 2.5 Results
troubleshooting.subtitle: Wan 2.5 performs best when the prompt is concrete, short, and timed to the selected duration.

items.title: Describe one main action
items.desc: A single clear action usually works better than several scene changes in a 5 or 10 second clip.

items.title: Add camera direction
items.desc: Use words like slow push-in, locked tripod, top-down macro, handheld, orbit, or gentle parallax.

items.title: Write audio as part of the scene
items.desc: Mention crisp cutting, soft pouring, cloth rustle, room tone, ambience, or dialogue only when you want native audio output.

faq.q: What is Wan 2.5 AI Video Generator?
faq.a: Wan 2.5 creates short AI videos with Alibaba’s Wan family model. On Toolaze, you can use text-to-video or image-to-video, then control prompt, aspect ratio, duration, resolution, and native audio output.

faq.q: Does Wan 2.5 support image-to-video on Toolaze?
faq.a: Yes. Toolaze exposes image-to-video for Wan 2.5 with one uploaded reference image. The prompt should explain what should move and what should stay consistent.
Yes. You can start with a text prompt, describe the subject, action, camera, lighting, style, and sound, then generate a short video.

faq.q: What duration and resolution can I choose?
faq.a: The Toolaze Wan 2.5 setup offers 5 or 10 second clips at 720p or 1080p.

faq.q: Can Wan 2.5 create videos with sound?
faq.a: Wan 2.5 supports native audio output on Toolaze, so prompts can include synchronized sound, ambience, material sound, or audio mood when that setting is enabled.

faq.q: How many reference images can Wan 2.5 use?
faq.a: On Toolaze, Wan 2.5 uses one uploaded image for image-to-video. Choose a clear starting frame with the subject already visible.
Access can depend on your current credits, account state, model availability, duration, and resolution. The generator shows the current requirement before generation.

faq.q: When should I choose Wan 2.5 instead of Wan 2.7?
faq.a: Choose Wan 2.5 for a focused short-form page and straightforward 5 or 10 second clips. Try Wan 2.7 from the model selector when you want the latest Wan option or broader current controls.
